title: The Twin Storm Discipline
summary: The school course in raising two small storms side by side and ending a fight with the school's duet of weather.

title: Manual of the Paired Thunder Guard
summary: The school manual of guarding in pairs with thunder so that one peal breaks the blow and the other returns it.

title: The Basin and River Tempest Canon
summary: The school canon of filling a basin with storm qi and letting it run out as a flood along the river's course.

title: The Dual-Track Crown of Storms
summary: The school's high course of two tracks of storm qi that meet at the crown in a single world-shaking fall.

title: The Wind-Sworn Squall Discipline
summary: The school discipline of swearing the squall to the wind and holding that oath through every gust and every blow.

title: Plateau Thunder Reckoning
summary: The school reckoning of broad level thunder that bears the user and breaks whatever is sent against the plateau.

title: The Gale-Sworn Storm Canon
summary: The school canon of storms sworn to the wind that stand against the gale and answer it with a tempest of their own.

title: The Oath Beneath the Tempest
summary: The school's deepest oath sworn to the ground beneath the storm and loosed upward as a rising tempest.
